question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), DemoBooth_NVIDIA had an average headcount of approximately 15.5, while DemoBooth_Intel had about 10.6. The ratio of their average headcounts was approximately 1.46, indicating that DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'}) 
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_hc_nvidia
}
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_Intel'}) 
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_hc_intel
}
RETURN avg_hc_nvidia, avg_hc_intel, 
       CASE 
         WHEN avg_hc_intel > 0 THEN avg_hc_nvidia / avg_hc_intel 
         ELSE null 
       END AS ratio
